leads.summary: Emprendedor busca desarrollador para crear un simulador competitivo de subastas en Roblox con mecánicas en tiempo real.
leads.opener: Hola, vi tu propuesta para desarrollar 'Subastas LOCA' en Roblox. Tengo experiencia en desarrollo de juegos y sistemas lógicos en Luau/Roblox, ¿conversamos?
leads.text:
Desarrolla Subastas LOCA en Roblox
# SUBASTAS LOCA — Desarrollo de un simulador competitivo de subastas en Roblox

## 1. Descripción general del proyecto

Quiero desarrollar un juego de Roblox llamado **Subastas LOCA**, inspirado en los simuladores competitivos y los juegos de colección, pero con un sistema de subastas en tiempo real.

En el juego habrá un subastador que presentará objetos aleatorios cada cierto tiempo. Los jugadores competirán pujando dinero por ellos. Cuando nadie quiera ofrecer más dinero, el jugador que haya realizado la última puja válida ganará el objeto, lo llevará a su base y podrá colocarlo en un espacio para generar dinero automáticamente.

El objetivo es conseguir objetos cada vez más valiosos, aumentar los ingresos, mejorar la colección, competir contra otros jugadores y convertirse en el jugador más rico del servidor.

Busco un juego divertido, adictivo, competitivo, bien optimizado y con una interfaz moderna.

## 2. Sistema principal de subastas

- Un NPC subastador presentará los objetos en una zona central.
- Los objetos aparecerán aleatoriamente según su rareza y las probabilidades configuradas.
- Cada subasta tendrá un tiempo de puja determinado.
- Los jugadores podrán realizar ofertas usando su dinero del juego.
- Cada nueva oferta válida deberá superar la puja actual.
- Cuando termine el tiempo sin nuevas pujas, ganará el jugador que haya realizado la última oferta válida.
- El dinero de la oferta ganadora se descontará del saldo del jugador y el objeto se entregará a su inventario.
- Si nadie puja, el objeto no tendrá ganador y se retirará de la zona de subasta.
- Si alguien puja cuando el tiempo está a punto de terminar, el sistema podrá reiniciar brevemente la cuenta atrás para evitar que una oferta válida quede sin registrar.

El sistema debe ser seguro: las ofertas, el dinero y la elección del ganador deben validarse en el servidor para evitar trampas.

leads.summary: Un negocio necesita una aplicacion de escritorio personalizada para control de ventas, facturacion y reportes.
leads.opener: Hi! I build custom desktop applications with clean interfaces and local databases. I can deliver the Windows installer, source code, and PDF exports you need. Let's talk!
leads.text:
Desktop Sales & Invoicing Tracker
I need a custom desktop application that lets me keep all sales-related data in one place. The core workflow should allow me to enter customer details, log every sale, generate an invoice on the spot, and come back later to pull reports that summarise totals, outstanding balances, and other key figures.  

Ideally the program opens quickly on any modern computer, stores its data safely (local database is fine, but I am open to a lightweight cloud sync option if it adds little overhead), and exports reports or invoices to PDF or CSV so the figures can move straight into my accountant’s system. A clean, uncluttered interface is important because I’ll be in and out of the software all day.  

For a smooth hand-off, please provide:  
• A ready-to-run installer (Windows first; cross-platform is a plus)  
• All source code with basic build instructions  
• A short user guide that shows how to add a customer, record a sale, and issue an invoice  
Once I can perform those three tasks and pull a monthly sales report without errors, I’ll consider the job complete.
Presupuesto: 250.0-750.0 CAD
Skills: PHP, .NET, C# Programming, Software Architecture, Software Development, Application Performance Monitoring

leads.summary: Fundador de SaaS busca QA freelancer para realizar pruebas funcionales y automatizadas en entorno de pruebas.
leads.opener: Hola, vi tu proyecto para probar las funciones principales de tu SaaS. Tengo experiencia con Selenium y Playwright, y puedo entregarte un informe detallado con casos de prueba y evidencias. ¿Lo conversamos?
leads.text:
Pruebas funcionales SaaS detalladas
Necesito que pongas a prueba las funciones principales de mi plataforma SaaS. Me interesa, sobre todo, comprobar tres cosas:

• Que cada función haga exactamente lo que debe.  
• Que los datos se guarden y se muestren correctamente.  
• Que los usuarios puedan completar sus tareas sin errores.

El entregable debe ser un paquete de casos de prueba con los resultados obtenidos y tus recomendaciones. Incluye descripción del caso, pasos seguidos, resultado esperado, resultado real y tu sugerencia de mejora. Si detectas cuellos de botella o pequeñas optimizaciones de UX, agrégalas.

La aplicación está disponible vía web; te facilitaré acceso a un entorno de pruebas y las credenciales necesarias. Puedes utilizar las herramientas de testing que prefieras (Selenium, Postman, Playwright, etc.), siempre que adjuntes evidencias claras ‑ capturas, logs o vídeos cortos.

Busco un informe claro, estructurado y accionable que me permita priorizar correcciones y mejoras rápidamente.
Presupuesto: 10.0-30.0 USD
Skills: Testing / QA, Software Testing, Test Automation, Test Strategy Writing, Test Plan Writing, Selenium

leads.summary: Desarrollador de Roblox busca programador en Lua para refactorizar el backend de su juego de rol estilo Chicago.
leads.opener: Hi! I have strong experience writing clean, modular Lua code for Roblox and optimizing server/client architecture. I'd love to help clean up your codebase.
leads.text:
Optimize Chicago Hood Roblox RP
My Chicago-style hood role-play experience runs, but the back-end has turned into spaghetti. I want the game systems—especially everything that powers vehicles, weapons and the shop network—re-organised into clean, modular Lua code that follows Roblox-friendly patterns (server/client separation, RemoteEvents, ModuleScripts, Folder hierarchy, etc.).  

A tight script structure should also translate into noticeably smoother play and faster load times on mobile, but the first milestone is simply getting the codebase tidy, readable and easy to extend.  

Deliverables  
• Re-factored weapon and shop scripts grouped logically in Roblox Studio  
• Clear in-code comments and a short hand-off document explaining the new architecture and how to add future content  
• No gameplay changes—functionality must match the current live build  

Send a brief note linking past Roblox work where you performed similar optimisation or system refactors; that’s the main thing I’ll review before awarding.
Presupuesto: 30.0-250.0 USD
Skills: Game Design, Software Development, Game Development, Lua, Scripting, Backend Development

leads.summary: Una empresa necesita un flujo de trabajo en UiPath para automatizar la descarga y envío diario de un reporte.
leads.opener: Hi there! I have strong experience building unattended UiPath workflows and automated report emailers. I can deliver this .xaml solution quickly. Let's connect!
leads.text:
Daily UiPath Report Emailer
I need a UiPath workflow that logs into our web portal, triggers the daily report, waits until the report is ready, and immediately emails it to our team mailing list. The schedule is fixed: the robot should run once every day at the set time we specify in Orchestrator, so no data-change checks or weekly logic are required.

The email must include the freshly generated report as an attachment (PDF or Excel—whichever the site produces) and a short, configurable body text. Please build the process in UiPath Studio, make it unattended-ready, and rely on standard activities compatible with Orchestrator, Outlook (or SMTP), and the latest UiPath.System and UiPath.Mail packages.

Deliverables  
• Completed .xaml workflow with any reusable components  
• Asset/queue definitions or config file for credentials, URL, schedule time, and mailing list address  
• One-page setup guide so I can deploy and test it quickly in our own Orchestrator tenant

If you have a similar automation in your portfolio, let me know; otherwise, a concise explanation of your approach will help me choose the right partner.
Presupuesto: 15.0-25.0 USD
Skills: .NET, Excel, C# Programming, Software Architecture, PDF, WPF

leads.summary: Un cliente busca desarrollar una app multiplataforma de entrega de alimentos y comestibles con apps para clientes, repartidores y panel de administración.
leads.opener: Hi, I read your requirements for the multi-vendor grocery delivery app. I specialize in Flutter/React Native and backend development. Let's discuss your tech stack and timeline.
leads.text:
Multi-Vendor Food & Grocery App
I need a production-ready multi-vendor delivery solution that does for fresh produce, groceries and household staples what Swiggy and Zomato do for prepared meals.

Scope  
• Customer ordering app – iOS and Android, built with a cross-platform stack such as Flutter or React-Native, that shows nearby vendors, real-time search, cart, multiple payment gateways, live order tracking and push notifications.  
• Delivery partner app – separate mobile app that accepts jobs, offers in-app navigation, earnings summary and status toggles (online/offline).  

Ordering flow  
End-users must be able to browse or search, add fruit, vegetables and grocery items to a single basket and check out in one smooth journey. Scheduled delivery, instant delivery and in-store pickup can stay flexible for phase two, but the architecture should keep those options open.

Vendor types supported at launch  
• Fresh vegetables and fruits  
• Grocery and household essentials  

Tech & compliance  
Clean, documented code, REST / GraphQL APIs, admin dashboard for inventory and order management, GDPR-ready user data handling and scalable deployment on AWS, GCP or Azure. I prefer seeing unit tests or at least Postman collections that prove each endpoint works.

Deliverables  
1. Source code for both mobile apps and backend  
2. One-click build instructions and environment files  
3. Deployed staging environment for live testing  
4. Brief video walkthrough and handover call  

I will review the build against the above checklist, run a few end-to-end orders and release milestones as each module clears testing.
Presupuesto: 75000.0-150000.0 INR
Skills: PHP, Mobile App Development, iPhone, Android, iOS Development, React Native

leads.summary: Fundador de un estudio de fitness necesita el desarrollo completo de un sitio web responsivo con panel de administración en React.
leads.opener: Hi! I saw your post regarding the fitness studio website and React admin dashboard. I have strong experience building fast, responsive sites with React and custom backends.
leads.text:
Responsive Fitness Studio Website -- 2
I’m launching a fresh website for a neighborhood fitness studio and need someone who can take it from wireframe to deployment within 3–4 weeks.

The build must be fully responsive, fast-loading, and SEO-ready. A bold hero banner on the home page should flow into studio highlights and a single, persuasive call-to-action that pushes visitors to book a class.

Core pages
• Classes  
• Trainers  
• Pricing  
• Contact  

Key features
• Booking request form that emails me each submission so I can confirm slots manually. Required fields: name, contact details, preferred class, date, and time.  
• Photo gallery and rotating customer testimonials for social proof.  
• Contact page with embedded Google Map and a separate inquiry form.  

Self-management
I want a custom React admin dashboard where I can update class schedules, pricing tables, and gallery images with no code. Clean, intuitive UI/UX is essential so day-to-day edits take minutes, not hours.

Tech stack
HTML / CSS, modern JavaScript, React for both the public site and the admin panel (open to a headless CMS or lightweight Node back end if that speeds development). Performance tuning, image optimisation, and basic on-page SEO need to be baked in from the start.

Deliverables
• Fully functioning website on my domain  
• Source code and build files  
• Short handover guide covering deployment, admin login, and routine updates  

When you bid, please include two or three relevant portfolio links and your estimated schedule that fits the 3–4 week window. I’ll review design quality, UX flow, and mobile performance closely.
Presupuesto: 12500.0-37500.0 INR
Skills: PHP, JavaScript, Website Design, Graphic Design, SEO, CSS

leads.summary: Un cliente busca contratar un desarrollador para crear una herramienta en tiempo real de notas y transcripción para Google Meet.
leads.opener: Hi! I can build this Google Meet real-time note-taking tool for you as a lightweight Chrome extension or web app. Let's discuss the audio capture pipeline.
leads.text:
Google Meet Live Note-Taking
I want a small, reliable tool that listens to spoken conversation in an active Google Meet and turns it into clear, well-formatted written notes while the meeting is still in progress. English is the only language I need to support, so you can focus all speech-to-text tuning, punctuation handling, and speaker-label logic on that single locale.

A concise overlay or side-panel inside the Meet window (or a separate browser tab if that’s simpler) is fine, as long as participants can scan the evolving notes without leaving the call. When the meeting ends, the full transcript should already be cleaned up and ready to copy or download—no post-processing delays.

Please include:

• Real-time transcription pipeline (Web Speech API, Google Cloud Speech-to-Text, or any comparable engine).  
• Automatic paragraphing and time stamps every few minutes so the text is readable.  
• Quick export to Google Docs and plain-text.  
• Simple start/stop controls the host can trigger.

You’re free to build a lightweight Chrome extension, a small web app that sits alongside Meet, or another approach that respects Google’s embedding policies; just outline your plan up front so I know how you’ll hook into the call’s audio.

Acceptance criteria  
– Live English transcription appears with <2 s latency during a Google Meet.  
– Accuracy stays above 90 % in a quiet office scenario.  
– Final document downloads automatically when the host clicks “End notes”.

Let me know which API or library you prefer and any permissions I’ll need to grant for testing.
Presupuesto: 750.0-1250.0 INR
Skills: JavaScript, CSS, HTML, Web Development, Backend Development, Frontend Development

leads.summary: Cliente busca disenador y desarrollador para crear identidad visual y construir sitio web profesional en Squarespace con contenido listo.

leads.text:
Premium Squarespace Site & Branding
I already have the full site map and all page copy drafted; what I’m missing is the visual magic and technical build that will turn those words into a premium, trust-building online presence.

Here’s what I need from you:

• Visual identity: a refined logo (primary, secondary and simple icon mark) plus a polished colour palette that feels premium and elegant. I will apply this identity across print and social later, so please supply the working files and clear usage notes.

• Squarespace build: using my information architecture, create a clean, elegant site that showcases my services and establishes credibility. I’m open to whichever Squarespace template you feel suits the brief; the finished site should be responsive, fast, and easy for me to update on my own.

I’ll hand over:
– Final copy for every page, already proof-read
– A page-by-page wireframe so you can see hierarchy and desired calls-to-action
– Brand references that capture the premium tone I’m after

You’ll deliver:
– Logo files (AI, SVG, PNG) and colour codes
– A fully assembled Squarespace site connected to my domain, with basic SEO fields completed
– A short Loom or written walkthrough so I can edit text, images, and sections confidently

Timeline and milestones are flexible as long as we agree up front. If this sounds like the right fit, let’s get started—I’m ready to provide all content on day one.
Presupuesto: 250.0-750.0 AUD
